authoring_metadata.description: TOOL DEMO. SP input gain +20 dB plus +12 dB level drives the SP 12-bit converter into its code clamp on most peaks; interstage +12 dB and MPC MID drive the 18-bit converter clamp; trim pulled down. Reducing the trim does NOT undo the clamps upstream. Illustrative only.
